description: Fischer, DSSA AN sanitary silicone, ideal for wet rooms.Fischer sanitary silicone is suitable for grouting and waterproofing in sanitary and kitchen areas. The high abrasion resistance and good chemical resistance protect surfaces during cleaning and thus ensure a long service life of the joints. The excellent adhesion on smooth surfaces makes the silicone the ideal paste for joints in the bathroom and kitchen, whether for the installation of sink, shower or bathtub. The DSSA reliably seals and thanks to its high elasticity is also suitable for corner joints, movement and connection joints, expansion joints between tiles or window and glass sealant, on many building materials and smooth surfaces, such as chrome, stainless steel, anodized, enamel and glass. The practical cartridge ensures quick and easy grouting and sealing, no matter whether craftsmen, DIY enthusiasts and hobbyists. Spontaneous repairs when moving and repairs and renovations are no longer a hindrance.DSSA sanitary silicone has the following features:Colour: anthracite.Contents: 310 ml.Chemical Base: 1K Silicone AcetateProcessing time: approx. 6 minutes.Working temperature: +5°C to +40°C.Temperature resistance: -40°C to +180°C.Complies with DIN EN ISO 11600 F+G 25
